liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- Anders Osbourne sat in for a version of the Neil Young song that the reviewer found fantastic [2]
- George Porter took the lead vocal on this second-set tune [4]
- Vocals were shared among Alan, Porter and Karl on this second-set closer [4]

## Setlist highlights

- **soulive2012-02-24-d1t01**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [6]

## The recordings

- **soulive2012-02-24.soulive2012-02-24** (recommended): source not stated; 17 songs; 159 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [1]

## Around the show

- Guests were Karl Denson, George Porter Jr., and Anders Osbourne, who all sat in during the night [2]
- Soulive opened with a run of Beatles tunes, then Karl and George joined for a few Meters songs [2]
- Billed as Snowlive in Lake Tahoe, CA, with special guests George Porter Jr, Karl Denson and Anders Osborne [4]
- The crowd was extremely rowdy, which made it hard to capture a good stealth recording in the audience [5]
